candidates.reuse_note: The only widget that implements ctx.variant: decks 'ww1' and 'vietnam'. A third conflict means a third deck, not a new widget.
candidates.targets: Battlefield success and strategic victory are different scoreboards. Each side has its own victory condition and often a clock: Germany’s 1918 Spring Offensive gained more ground than any attack since 1914 yet failed strategically because it did not achieve a decisive result before American strength arrived — and the gains left long, indefensible lines. US search-and-destroy in Vietnam won engagements and body counts, yet the NLF’s condition was to NOT LOSE until American political will broke. The widget must make the two scoreboards concrete: the tactical metric can climb while the strategic position worsens. Build once — the two wars are scenario data for the same mechanism.
